definitions.explanation: Short for {美術大学|びじゅつだいがく}: a university that teaches the fine arts and design, such as painting, sculpture and graphic design. {美大生|びだいせい} is an art student.

examples.japanese: {美大|びだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美大|びだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: My brother studied oil painting at art college.

examples.japanese: {美大|びだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦デッサン→デッサン：23408_dessan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実技|じつぎ}→実技：16234_jitsugi⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The entrance exam for art colleges includes a practical drawing test.

notes:
Clipped from {美術大学|びじゅつだいがく}, the everyday name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美大生|びだいせい}: an art student
- {美大|びだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim to get into art college
- {美大|びだい}⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧: preparing for art college entrance exams

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {芸大|げいだい}: a university of the arts, usually covering music as well as fine art
